description: Defines the keyboard-only navigation contract for the future renderer. The Slice 007E § 10 keyboard flow is the canonical source; this fixture is the testable spec layer. Future component tests (007G+) will assert each keyboard event triggers the expected reducer action or focus movement. This fixture is spec only; no React, no IPC, no runtime.
scope: KnowledgeFlushConfirmationPanel (all 7 components must respect parent focus order)
no_runtime_requirement: Every keyboard event is dispatched to the local reducer; no IPC, no network, no file I/O.
tab_order: 18. Confirm Flush button (always in tab order, aria-disabled when not enabled)
phrase_input_assertions: input aria-invalid=true when state.confirmation_phrase_typed !== expected_phrase (after trim)
helper text visible on mismatch: 'Type the confirmation phrase verbatim to enable Confirm Flush.'
helper text hidden on match (or replaced with success hint)
risk_ack_assertions: Confirm Flush enablement recomputes via computeConfirmButtonEnabled

confirm_button_enablement.true_when: phase === 'open' && blocking_issue_count === 0 && risks_acknowledged === true && phrase_typed === expected_phrase

cancel_escape_behavior.Escape: dispatch({ type: 'close' }) → state resets to INITIAL_CONFIRMATION_STATE
cancel_escape_behavior.clean_state_required: after close or reject, phrase + acks must be cleared
